description: This file contains end-to-end test functions for export-related commands in the Mattermost server CLI, including listing, deleting, creating, downloading, showing, listing jobs, and canceling export jobs.

methods.name: TestExportListCmdF
methods.description: Tests the listing of export files with different permission and export scenarios.

methods.name: TestExportDeleteCmdF
methods.description: Tests deletion of export files, including permission checks and idempotence.

methods.name: TestExportCreateCmdF
methods.description: Tests creation of export jobs with various permission and flag configurations.

methods.name: TestExportDownloadCmdF
methods.description: Tests downloading of export files, handling of existing files, non-existent files, and full download verification.

methods.name: TestExportJobShowCmdF
methods.description: Tests retrieval of specific export job details, including permission and existence checks.

methods.name: TestExportJobListCmdF
methods.description: Tests listing of export jobs with pagination and permission checks.

methods.name: TestExportJobCancelCmdF
methods.description: Tests canceling export jobs, including permission and job existence scenarios.
